statement: A durable CREATE TABLE job records NOT NULL and default semantics in its canonical intent, recovers after metadata projection and owner restart into a semantically identical schema against the same deterministic table identity, still fails closed on genuinely different metadata without overwrite or cleanup, and the unchanged movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live scenario reports priority metric 0 on three consecutive fresh runs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The persisted normalized_ddl and its recovered AST must project the same semantic schema for column nullability, defaults, primary keys, uniqueness, types, and constraints.

Recovery must retain the original deterministic job, table, and partition identities; genuinely different durable metadata must remain SCHEMA_INTENT_CONFLICT and must never be overwritten, deleted, repaired, or reseeded.

Deterministic evidence must project metadata from a NOT NULL DEFAULT schema, leave the durable job nonterminal, construct a fresh owner, recover that exact stored intent, and converge to READY; reverting the production correction must make this seam fail.

Do not remove the repeated CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, weaken or remove NOT NULL/default clauses, bypass the durable schema job, change MovieLens workload or budgets, or clean persisted metadata to manufacture success.

After source verification, run five fresh formation probes followed by three fresh MovieLens demos with one unchanged source fingerprint; stop on the first red result and diagnose the newly reached boundary before any rerun.
